svg.desc: Coordinate-derived pig Na/K-ATPase3WGU assembly1, protein-only deposited segments. Neutral-gray alpha authorA, dark-blue beta authorB, amber partialFXYD authorG. Positivez is extracellular-facing, negativez cytoplasmic-facing. No cycle or ion pathway shown.
